platform_scope.POSIX: macOS software tests use pinned directory/file descriptors, durable cleanup phases, no-replace quarantine rename, and descriptor-relative cleanup; final name operation is not inode-CAS against hostile same-UID races
platform_scope.Windows: exact-handle recursive directory cleanup remains typed unavailable and fenced; Windows kernel NOT_RUN

recovery_fault_controls: PREPARED durable intent with exact quarantine rename completed before QUARANTINED journal write; reopened recover reconciles exact owned inode and completes cleanup
QUARANTINED tree cleanup interrupted after one listed child removal; reopened recover accepts only manifest-listed hash-matching subset and completes cleanup
REMOVE_INTENT durable before root rmdir; interruption after rmdir and before DONE journal write; reopened recover reconciles only when both original and quarantine leaves are absent
same-content foreign quarantine substitution is refused during recovery and remains byte/inode preserved
